visualReview: Individually inspected native frame 01559 and exact crop. Body, clothing and wrist web remain intact in swing. Finger hooks are reduced, but the free hand still has a spread, three-pronged outline rather than a compact closed fist. Do not install on the strength of passing numeric contact checks.
diagnosis: The first static-palm fit had negative combined-pose middle-finger clearance. Dynamic-palm left settings then passed left sampled clearances but failed the right hand: middle tips below the palm and little tips without projected coverage. Separate right-hand fitting removed those sampled problems, but native closure remained inadequate. Next fit includes whole-digit forward reach, not fingertip clearance alone.
scope: Two genuine game framebuffer images from process-local input, not desktop capture. Offline signed sampled clearances are not full volumetric/finger collision acceptance. Exact geometry, source bind, weights, thumb and open-hand preservation passed 4196-frame isolation.
